SELECT ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(s.NumTstTakr, 0)) / COUNT(s.cds), 2) AS AvgSATTestTakers
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles' AND s.OpenDate BETWEEN '2007-01-01' AND '2007-12-31' AND s.DocType = 'County Office of Education';

SELECT 
    T1.`County Name`, 
    COUNT(T1.CDSCode) AS `Number of Schools`, 
    ROUND(AVG(T1.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`), 2) AS `Average Free-Meal Percentage`, 
    ROUND(AVG(T1.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`), 2) AS `Average FRPM Percentage`, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Number of Charter Schools`, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Number of Non-Charter Schools`, 
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.cds IS NOT NULL THEN T2.AvgScrRead + T2.AvgScrMath + T2.AvgScrWrite ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(T1.CDSCode), 2) AS `Average SAT Score`
FROM 
    frpm AS T1
LEFT JOIN 
    satscores AS T2 ON T2.cds = T1.CDSCode
WHERE 
    T1.`County Code` = (SELECT `County Code` FROM frpm WHERE CDSCode = '1612590125716')
    AND T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 500
    AND T1.`FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    ROUND(f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`, 4) AS FreeMealRate,
    CASE 
        WHEN s.Charter = 1 THEN 'Yes'
        WHEN s.Charter = 0 THEN 'No'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS Charter,
    s.GSserved,
    CASE 
        WHEN s.GSserved = 'K-12' THEN 'Above Average'
        WHEN s.GSserved = 'K-8' THEN 'Average'
        WHEN s.GSserved = 'K-5' THEN 'Below Average'
        ELSE 'No SAT Data'
    END AS SATPerformance
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.County = 'Alameda' 
    AND s.GSserved = 'K-12'
ORDER BY 
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.School AS SchoolName,
    s.Phone,
    s.Website,
    st.AvgScrRead,
    st.AvgScrMath,
    st.AvgScrWrite,
    CASE WHEN s.Charter = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Charter,
    fr.`Enrollment (K-12)`,
    ROUND(fr.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)], 2) AS FreeMealPercent,
    (SELECT MAX(AvgScrMath) FROM satscores WHERE cds IN (SELECT CDSCode FROM schools WHERE StatusType = 'Active') AND NumTstTakr >= 10) AS HighestAvgScrMath,
    (SELECT MAX(AvgScrMath) FROM satscores WHERE cds IN (SELECT CDSCode FROM schools WHERE StatusType = 'Active') AND NumTstTakr >= 10) - st.AvgScrMath AS MathScoreBelowHighest
FROM 
    schools s
INNER JOIN 
    satscores st ON s.CDSCode = st.cds
INNER JOIN 
    frpm fr ON s.CDSCode = fr.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.CDSCode = '7618040113118';

WITH VirtualSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        s.County,
        s.School,
        AVG(sats.AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadScore
    FROM 
        schools s
    LEFT JOIN 
        satscores sats ON s.CDSCode = sats.cds
    WHERE 
        s.Virtual = 1
    GROUP BY 
        s.County, s.School
),
RankedVirtualSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        County,
        COUNT(School) AS VirtualSchoolCount,
        MAX(AvgReadScore) AS MaxAvgReadScore
    FROM 
        VirtualSchools
    GROUP BY 
        County
),
TopCounties AS (
    SELECT 
        County,
        VirtualSchoolCount,
        MaxAvgReadScore
    FROM 
        RankedVirtualSchools
    ORDER BY 
        VirtualSchoolCount DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
CountyDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        r.County,
        r.VirtualSchoolCount,
        r.MaxAvgReadScore,
        vs.School,
        vs.AvgReadScore
    FROM 
        RankedVirtualSchools r
    LEFT JOIN 
        VirtualSchools vs ON r.County = vs.County AND r.MaxAvgReadScore = vs.AvgReadScore
)
SELECT 
    County,
    VirtualSchoolCount,
    COALESCE(School, 'None') AS HighestAvgReadSchool
FROM 
    CountyDetails
ORDER BY 
    VirtualSchoolCount DESC;

FROM Player P

    FROM Player_Attributes pa3
    WHERE pa3.player_api_id = p.player_api_id AND pa3.date = pa.date

SELECT T1.district_id, T1.A2, T1.A3, T1.A4, T1.A5, T1.A6, T1.A7, T1.A8, T1.A9, T1.A10, T1.A11, T1.A12, T1.A13, T1.A14, T1.A15, T1.A16, COUNT(DISTINCT T2.account_id) AS account_count

SELECT T1.A2, SUM(T2.amount) AS total_amount
FROM district AS T1
INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
INNER JOIN loan AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id

GROUP BY T1.A2
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.account_id)

INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id 
INNER JOIN district AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id 
WHERE T3.A2 = 'North Bohemia' AND T1.date <= '1995-12-31' AND T1.bank = 'AB';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(T1.A10), 2) AS avg_salary, COUNT(T1.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district AS T1
INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
INNER JOIN client AS T3 ON T2.client_id = T3.client_id
WHERE T3.birth_date BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1989-12-31';

SELECT 
    a.account_id, 
    a.date, 
    SUM(l.amount) AS total_borrowed, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.account_to) + COUNT(DISTINCT o.account_from) AS counterparty_count, 
    c.district_id AS home_district, 
    d.A10 AS population, 
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY d.A10 DESC, a.account_id ASC) AS rank
FROM 
    account a

    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN 
    disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id

    client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id

    district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id

SELECT

ORDER BY

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(T1.amount), 2) AS percentage
FROM trans AS T1
INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A2 = 'Pisek')
AND T1.type = 'OUTGOING';

WITH district_pop AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A2,
        COUNT(c.client_id) AS num_clients
    FROM
        district d
    LEFT JOIN
        client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    GROUP BY
        d.district_id, d.A2
    ORDER BY
        num_clients DESC, d.A2 COLLATE NOCASE
    LIMIT 3
),
crime_counts AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        COUNT(o.order_id) AS num_crimes
    FROM
        district d
    LEFT JOIN
        account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    LEFT JOIN
        `order` o ON a.account_id = o.account_id
    WHERE
        o.date BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY
        d.district_id
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(COALESCE(num_crimes, 0)) AS avg_crimes
    FROM
        crime_counts
)
SELECT
    dp.A2 AS district_name,
    dp.num_clients AS population,
    cc.num_crimes AS num_crimes,
    ROUND(ov.avg_crimes, 2) AS avg_crimes_overall,
    ROUND(dp.num_clients * cc.num_crimes / 1000000.0, 2) AS avg_crimes_per_million,
    ROUND(dp.num_clients * cc.num_crimes / 1000000.0 - ov.avg_crimes, 2) AS diff
FROM
    district_pop dp
JOIN
    crime_counts cc ON dp.district_id = cc.district_id
CROSS JOIN
    overall_avg ov;

WITH district_info AS (
    SELECT 
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.region,
        MAX(CASE WHEN t.date <= '1996-12-31' THEN t.balance ELSE 0 END) AS end_of_1996_balance
    FROM 
        district d
    JOIN 
        disp disp ON d.district_id = disp.district_id
    JOIN 
        account acc ON disp.account_id = acc.account_id
    JOIN 
        trans t ON acc.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE 
        acc.issued LIKE '1996%'
    GROUP BY 
        d.district_id, d.A2, d.region
),
region_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(end_of_1996_balance) AS region_avg_balance
    FROM 
        district_info
)
SELECT 
    district_name,
    COUNT(account_id) AS num_accounts_opened,
    ROUND(AVG(end_of_1996_balance), 2) AS avg_end_of_1996_balance,
    (SELECT region_avg_balance FROM region_average) AS region_avg_balance,
    (SELECT district_name FROM district_info ORDER BY avg_end_of_1996_balance DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 1) AS highest_avg_balance_district
FROM 
    district_info
ORDER BY 
    district_name;

SELECT d.A2 AS branch_name, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.date <= '1998-10-14' AND t.operation IS NULL
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    T1.bank, 
    T1.account, 
    COUNT(T1.trans_id) AS payment_count, 
    SUM(T1.amount) AS total_amount
FROM 
    trans AS T1
JOIN 
    loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE 
    T2.loan_id = 98832 
    AND T2.status = 'approved' 
    AND T1.date < '1996-01-03' 
    AND T1.type = 'VYDAJ'
GROUP BY 
    T1.bank, T1.account
ORDER BY 
    total_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS region,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS district_count,
    SUM(c.A10) AS combined_population,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS account_count
FROM 
    district d
JOIN 
    client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
JOIN 
    disp disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN 
    account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id

    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id

    l.duration > 24 AND l.date < '1997-01-01'
GROUP BY 
    d.A2

LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(T3.A10), 2) AS average_salary
FROM client AS T1
INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
INNER JOIN district AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'F' AND T1.birth_date < '1930-01-01';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(T2.A10), 2) AS avg_salary
FROM client AS T1
INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id

SELECT ROUND(AVG(T2.A10), 2) AS average_salary

WHERE T1.amount < 100000 AND T1.status = 'running';

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality, MAX(ds.points) AS max_points

GROUP BY d.driverId
ORDER BY max_points DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    ROUND((1 - (MIN(T1.milliseconds) / MAX(T1.milliseconds))) * 100, 2) AS percentage_shorter
FROM 
    results AS T1
INNER JOIN 
    races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId
WHERE 
    T2.year = 1988 AND T2.name = 'Australian Grand Prix';

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.laps = T2.laps THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM results AS T1
INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceid = T2.raceid
INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T1.driverid = T3.driverid
WHERE T3.nationality = 'Japanese' AND T2.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.bdob < '1985-01-01' AND T2.laps > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) 
FROM drivers AS T1 
INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.driverid = T2.driverid 
WHERE T2.raceid BETWEEN (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE YEAR = 2000) AND (SELECT raceid FROM races WHERE YEAR = 2005);

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers d
JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverId = q.driverId
JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE c.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit' AND r.year = 2008 AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY q.q3 ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(T2.stops), 2) AS average_pit_stops
FROM races AS T1
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT raceId, COUNT(*) AS stops
    FROM pitStops
    GROUP BY raceId
) AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId
WHERE T1.year = 2017 AND T1.year NOT IN (SELECT year FROM races WHERE year = 2000);

SELECT

    d.surname,

JOIN qualifying AS T2 ON T1.driverid = T2.driverid

LIMIT 1;

)

LIMIT 1;

ORDER BY

LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT driverId)

FROM drivers d

ORDER BY q.q2 ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT q3, driverid, driverref
FROM qualifying
WHERE raceid = (
    SELECT raceid
    FROM races
    WHERE name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND YEAR = 2017
) AND q3 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY q3 ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.nationality
FROM drivers AS T1
JOIN qualifying AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
WHERE T2.q3 = ( SELECT MAX(q3) FROM qualifying WHERE raceId = ( SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND YEAR = 2017 ) )

SELECT 
    s.year,
    MIN(T2.milliseconds) - MIN(T1.milliseconds) AS time_gap
FROM 
    races AS T1
INNER JOIN 
    results AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId
INNER JOIN 
    constructors AS T3 ON T2.constructorId = T3.constructorId

    circuits AS T4 ON T1.circuitId = T4.circuitId

    MIN(T1.time) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.year, T4.forename, T4.surname, T3.time

INNER JOIN drivers AS T4 ON T3.driverid = T4.driverid

WHERE T1.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND T1.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017 AND (T3.position = 1 OR T3.positionText = '1') AND T3.time <= '17:00:00'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.forename, T1.surname

WHERE T2.year = 1957 AND T2.country = 'United Kingdom' AND T2.name = 'British Grand Prix';
